name: code
description: code — coding-workflow plugin. Sub-skills for the manager/router engineering loop: `code:loop` drains a queue end-to-end (single ticket or many) with mindset-grounded autonomy and inline verification, `code:review` is one skill with three modes — session PRs by default, a deep cold review given PR number(s) (file:line grounding, architecture rubric, security pass), or a read-only whole-repo architecture-and-quality scan given `repo`/a path/`--since` — `code:learn` learns a codebase and writes durable navigation notes into the project's own AGENTS.md, folding a genuine coding-workflow lesson back into the plugin only secondarily. `/commit` splits the working tree into the maximum number of small logical commits. `code:review` spawns the repo's `code-reviewer` subagent (shipped from the top-level subagents/ layer, not from this plugin) for the non-author review. Publishing a distributable lives at the top-level `/release` command, not in this plugin. Also ships three self-contained commands beyond the loop: `/code:prune` removes merged branches and worktrees behind hard data-loss guards (skips anything with uncommitted changes, stashes, unmerged commits, locks, or detached HEAD, using `git rev-list --count origin/$MAIN..HEAD == 0` as the load-bearing 'nothing to lose' check), `/code:tag-release` cuts and pushes an annotated release tag (never force, never re-points an existing tag), and `/code:clean` identifies and cleans up technical debt, near-duplicates, scattered sources of truth, and dead code.
